{"people":[{"name":"Dana","role":"Account executive (rep)","side":"us"},{"name":"PMM","role":"Product marketer (interviewer)","side":"us"},{"name":"Wen","role":"Solutions engineer","side":"us"},{"name":"Ines","role":"CFO, new (about four months in); signed the deal","side":"customer"},{"name":"Paul","role":"IT director; rep's day-to-day contact","side":"customer"},{"name":"the controller","role":"Controller (unnamed); sent statements and worked out the hours","side":"customer"},{"name":"bank rep","role":"Customer's bank contact (incumbent Fiserv relationship); had changed","side":"competitor"}],
"competitors":["Fiserv"],
"incumbent":"Fiserv, through their bank",
"evidence":[
{"id":"E1","turn":2,"excerpt":"I thought it was the online ordering portal. That's what the inbound said.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Inbound framed the trigger as the ordering portal; the rep's initial read."},
{"id":"E2","turn":2,"excerpt":"They were building a portal so a chef could reorder at midnight.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Says the customer was 'building' the portal; conflicts with the off-the-shelf portal in T14."},
{"id":"E3","turn":2,"excerpt":"So I went in pitching checkout.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"The initial pitch angle was checkout, not reconciliation."},
{"id":"E4","turn":4,"excerpt":"The portal was the excuse.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Rep reframes the portal as a pretext rather than the real trigger."},
{"id":"E5","turn":4,"excerpt":"I didn't get this until maybe the third call, was they had a new CFO. Ines. She'd been there about four months, and her first month-end close took nine days.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Real trigger: a new CFO and a nine-day close. Discovered late."},
{"id":"E6","turn":4,"excerpt":"two people in finance matching deposits from the bank against the processor statements against invoices in the ERP. By hand, in spreadsheets.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"The concrete manual reconciliation pain behind the close."},
{"id":"E7","turn":4,"excerpt":"month-end is a week of archaeology.","label":"quote","speaker":"Ines (CFO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger","language"],"note":"Verbatim customer framing of the problem; the rep wrote it down."},
{"id":"E8","turn":6,"excerpt":"Ines. A hundred percent.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Rep's confident identification of the decider."},
{"id":"E9","turn":6,"excerpt":"I can recommend, she decides.","label":"quote","speaker":"Paul (IT director)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Customer confirms the CFO is the decision maker."},
{"id":"E10","turn":6,"excerpt":"she's the one who signed.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","outcome"],"note":"The signature confirms both the decider and that the deal was won."},
{"id":"E11","turn":8,"excerpt":"We sent the first proposal to Paul and it was all about the portal. The checkout, the APIs.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"First proposal was aimed at the wrong problem and the wrong person."},
{"id":"E12","turn":8,"excerpt":"Then nothing happened for three weeks.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Stall after the portal-focused proposal."},
{"id":"E13","turn":8,"excerpt":"Paul had forwarded it to her, she read the first page and said it wasn't her problem.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["message","decider"],"note":"The decider rejected the portal framing. Her words are paraphrased, not quoted."},
{"id":"E14","turn":10,"excerpt":"Fiserv was the incumbent, through their bank.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Identifies the incumbent and its bank-bundled channel."},
{"id":"E15","turn":10,"excerpt":"I honestly don't know what Fiserv showed them, if anything. I never saw a deck.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Rep has no direct knowledge of the competitor's pitch."},
{"id":"E16","turn":10,"excerpt":"we can take a look at your rates.","label":"quote","speaker":"bank (relayed by Ines)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Incumbent responded on price. Ines relayed this to the rep."},
{"id":"E17","turn":10,"excerpt":"I didn't ask about my rates.","label":"quote","speaker":"Ines (CFO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","language"],"note":"The customer was not price-driven. The incumbent misread her need."},
{"id":"E18","turn":12,"excerpt":"Not much. If anything she got more annoyed.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Says little changed, then immediately describes a new question."},
{"id":"E19","turn":12,"excerpt":"She did ask us one new thing afterwards, whether she'd get a named contact.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Changed question after the bank call: wanted a named relationship contact."},
{"id":"E20","turn":12,"excerpt":"Her bank rep had changed and she didn't know who the new one was.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Incumbent weakness: relationship churn and no known contact."},
{"id":"E21","turn":14,"excerpt":"Silence was the whole opening. I ran the standard first-call deck. Financial infrastructure, global growth, all the currencies.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"The standard positioning got silence from this customer."},
{"id":"E22","turn":14,"excerpt":"They sell to restaurants in three states.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"A regional business; global and multi-currency messaging was irrelevant."},
{"id":"E23","turn":14,"excerpt":"Paul was polite about it. Ines wasn't on that call, thank god.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","decider"],"note":"The decider missed the weak opening pitch."},
{"id":"E24","turn":14,"excerpt":"the developer story went nowhere. Paul's team is four people and they aren't building anything.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Developer positioning failed with a small IT team that builds nothing."},
{"id":"E25","turn":14,"excerpt":"The portal is off the shelf with a plugin.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger","message"],"note":"Conflicts with E2: the customer was not building the portal."},
{"id":"E26","turn":14,"excerpt":"The reaction was the payout reconciliation. Our solutions engineer, Wen, showed how each payout ties back to the individual transactions and how that feeds the ERP.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Reconciliation into the ERP was the message that landed."},
{"id":"E27","turn":14,"excerpt":"go back.","label":"quote","speaker":"Ines (CFO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"The decider interrupted the demo to revisit reconciliation."},
{"id":"E28","turn":14,"excerpt":"Then she asked if she could see it with their data.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","decided"],"note":"Asked for proof on her own data, which set up the turning point."},
{"id":"E29","turn":16,"excerpt":"That meeting. Well, the one after.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Rep self-corrects on which meeting won the deal."},
{"id":"E30","turn":16,"excerpt":"Wen asked for one month of their statements, the controller sent them over","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"The customer shared real data, a strong engagement signal."},
{"id":"E31","turn":16,"excerpt":"It was something like 60 hours a month across two people.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Hedged estimate of the manual effort, worked out with the controller."},
{"id":"E32","turn":16,"excerpt":"I don't remember the exact figure. Low six figures a year.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Vague dollar value. The exact business-case number was not recalled."},
{"id":"E33","turn":16,"excerpt":"that's my number, not yours.","label":"quote","speaker":"Ines (CFO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","language"],"note":"An ROI built from customer data is what won her over."},
{"id":"E34","turn":16,"excerpt":"After that it was paperwork.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","outcome"],"note":"The deal was effectively won at the data-based ROI meeting."},
{"id":"E35","turn":18,"excerpt":"Dead, honestly. I had it at 20 percent.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Low confidence before the ROI meeting."},
{"id":"E36","turn":20,"excerpt":"She wanted to talk to another distributor. Wholesale, invoices, that kind of business.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Gap: no peer reference from a distributor or wholesale business."},
{"id":"E37","turn":20,"excerpt":"We had retail stories and software stories.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Case-study library lacks the wholesale/distribution vertical."},
{"id":"E38","turn":20,"excerpt":"this is a company that sells sweaters.","label":"quote","speaker":"Ines (CFO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","language"],"note":"She dismissed the retail case study as irrelevant."},
{"id":"E39","turn":20,"excerpt":"We never got her a call. She signed anyway, but she brought it up twice.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","outcome"],"note":"Unresolved gap, raised repeatedly, but it did not block the signature."},
{"id":"E40","turn":20,"excerpt":"They have 14 branches with counter sales, and she asked if the card readers at the counter would land in the same report.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Branch card-present reconciliation was a stated need."},
{"id":"E41","turn":20,"excerpt":"Wen said yes and showed a slide. We didn't demo it. She let it go.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","outcome"],"note":"Branch POS capability was not demonstrated; unclear whether the branches are in scope."},
{"id":"E42","turn":22,"excerpt":"I just want to know where my money is.","label":"quote","speaker":"Ines (CFO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"The customer's most-repeated problem statement."},
{"id":"E43","turn":22,"excerpt":"She never once said \"payments.\" She'd say \"the deposits.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"The customer's vocabulary differs from our category term."},
{"id":"E44","turn":22,"excerpt":"Paul would say \"the processor.\" Nobody said \"infrastructure.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Our 'infrastructure' positioning term was absent from customer language."},
{"id":"E45","turn":24,"excerpt":"Find the CFO sooner. I lost a month pitching a portal.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger","decider"],"note":"Rep's lesson: the economic buyer was found late."}
],
"contradictions":[
{"evidence":["E2","E25","E24"],"what":"Rep first says the customer was 'building a portal', later says the portal is off the shelf with a plugin and the team isn't building anything."},
{"evidence":["E1","E3","E4","E5"],"what":"The stated trigger (ordering portal, per the inbound) differs from the real trigger (the new CFO's nine-day month-end close)."},
{"evidence":["E18","E19"],"what":"Rep says 'not much' changed after the bank call, then describes a new question about a named contact."},
{"evidence":["E12","E45"],"what":"The stall is described as three weeks, but the rep says they 'lost a month' pitching the portal."},
{"evidence":["E29"],"what":"Rep self-corrects on when the deal was won: 'that meeting', then 'the one after'."}
],
"dodges":[
{"question":"What did the customer bring up about the competitor?","turn":10,"what":"Rep doesn't know what Fiserv showed and never saw a deck; closes with 'That's about all I've got.'"},
{"question":"What changed in their questions after they'd talked to the bank?","turn":12,"what":"Answered 'Not much', then described a new named-contact question."},
{"question":"When did you first feel this was won? What happened right before?","turn":16,"what":"Hedged hours ('something like') and couldn't recall the exact dollar figure ('Low six figures')."}
],
"skipped":[],
"language_pairs":[
{"theirs":"the deposits","ours":"payments","evidence":["E43"]},
{"theirs":"the processor","ours":"financial infrastructure","evidence":["E44","E21"]},
{"theirs":"I just want to know where my money is","ours":"payout reconciliation","evidence":["E42","E26"]},
{"theirs":"month-end is a week of archaeology","ours":"payout reconciliation","evidence":["E7","E26"]},
{"theirs":"that's my number, not yours","ours":"dollar figure / business case built by Wen","evidence":["E33","E32"]},
{"theirs":"another distributor. Wholesale, invoices","ours":"retail stories and software stories","evidence":["E36","E37","E38"]},
{"theirs":"I didn't ask about my rates","ours":"we can take a look at your rates (incumbent bank)","evidence":["E17","E16"]}
],
"outcome_signals":[
{"evidence":["E10","E34"],"what":"Won: Ines signed; after the ROI meeting 'it was paperwork'."},
{"evidence":["E39"],"what":"She signed despite never getting a distributor reference."},
{"evidence":["E14","E16","E17"],"what":"Displaced the incumbent Fiserv/bank, at least for the reconciled flows; the full extent of the switch isn't stated."},
{"evidence":["E40","E41"],"what":"Partial-scope risk: the 14 branches' counter card readers were only shown on a slide, not demoed; unclear whether branch volume moved."},
{"evidence":["E35"],"what":"The deal sat at 20% before the data-based ROI meeting."}
]}
